name: Natural Language Processing
topics: NLP Overview, Phases and Pipeline
Define NLP and explain its phases/pipeline (phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics) with examples of each.
Explain two applications and challenges of NLP and how NLP components work together.
Text Pre-processing: Tokenization, Stop Words, Stemming, Lemmatization
Perform sentence tokenization, word tokenization and stop-word removal on the given paragraph.
Differentiate between stemming and lemmatization; explain derivational vs inflectional morphology.
Ambiguity in NLP
What is ambiguity? Explain the types of ambiguity in NLP with examples.
Identify the syntactic ambiguity in 'He saw the girl with the telescope' / 'The bank will not be open today' and how it can be resolved.
Syntax: Parsing and Parse Trees
What is parsing in NLP? Describe parsing techniques and how context-free grammars aid syntactic analysis.
Construct the parse tree for the given sentence and discuss the ambiguity that arises.
Semantic Analysis and Named Entity Recognition
What is semantic analysis in NLP? Explain with an example.
What is named entity recognition and what role does it play in NLP tasks?
Bag of Words and TF-IDF
Create bag-of-words and TF-IDF vectors for the given sentences using a term–document matrix, before and after cleaning.
Write the formula for TF-IDF and explain why IDF is called inverse document frequency.
Word Embeddings: Word2Vec (CBOW, Skip-gram), GloVe, Doc2Vec
Create Word2Vec vectors using CBOW and one-hot encoding for the given sentences; explain the skip-gram model.
Compare Word2Vec, Doc2Vec and GloVe; find the word–word co-occurrence matrix for the given sentences; explain king − man + woman = queen.
Text Corpus and Data Formats
Define a text corpus and list three types of corpora; explain the importance of corpus size and quality.
Explain how JSON and XML are used to store text data and how corpus formats affect pre-processing.
Machine Translation: Rule-based, Statistical, Neural and Anusaaraka
Compare rule-based, statistical and neural machine translation with examples; compare word-based and phrase-based MT.
Explain the architecture of the Anusaaraka system and the interlingua approach; explain smoothing and reordering in SMT.
Seq2Seq, Attention and Transformers
Explain sequence-to-sequence and attention models with diagrams and compare them.
What is a Transformer model? Explain how attention improves NMT over basic encoder–decoder models.
Chatbots, Conversational Models and Sentiment Analysis
Explain the working and types of conversational models and chatbot architectures.
Explain the types of sentiment analysis and how it works.
RNN, LSTM, GRU and CNN for NLP
Explain GRU and LSTM architectures and how they overcome the limitations of standard RNNs; discuss the advantages and disadvantages of LSTM.
Differentiate RNN and CNN in NLP; explain how CNN is used for sentence classification and the role of pre-trained embeddings.
NLP Libraries: NLTK and spaCy
Explain NLTK and spaCy; discuss the use of NLTK for deep learning-based NLP tasks with examples.
